name: dsh-degen-guard
description: Reasoning-degeneration guard for DeepSeek Harness: detects token-level repetition loops in the model's reasoning channel (same line repeated hundreds of times, no prose, no tool call, stream never idles), escalates early during the climb-up phase, fuses after repeated trips per session, drops a handoff note, and records the request summary at trip time, all through the official hook cancel cause.
author: MacilyDots

scripts.test: node test/test-detect.mjs && node test/test-request-tap.mjs && node test/test-plugin.mjs
